series.description: Four short chapters of original placeholder prose, written for this repository and bundled with the app. It never touches the network, so the reader always has something to open — and it exercises every text feature the reader supports: headings, scene breaks, quotations, lists, verse and translator's notes.

series.title: The Ninth Bell of the Meridian Gull
series.description: Twenty-four chapters aboard a sky-ferry that stays in the air because nine bells are rung in the right order, at the right hour, by people who have not slept. Sol Ferrant is sixteen, has the best ear on the ship, and is the only person willing to say out loud that the ninth bell has started answering someone else. Original sample content written for this repository — the long serial in the bundled catalogue, and the one to open when you want to test reading twenty-four chapters in a row.

series.title: Elevator to Floor Zero
series.description: Forty short chapters, most of them under four hundred words, every one of them ending somewhere you would rather it didn't. Ravi Oduya does nights in the Merridew Tower: thirty-one floors, two basements, and a freight elevator with a keyhole under the B2 button. He is very good at keeping a maintenance log. That turns out to matter more than anything else about him. Original sample content written for this repository — the serialized web-novel rhythm, for testing fast chapter-to-chapter navigation.
series.author: Pell Marrowick

series.title: The Weight of Still Water
series.description: Six long chapters, each of them the better part of an hour's reading. An archivist is sent to catalogue the village of Hallowmere in the six months before a reservoir drowns it, and finds a parish register that records five deaths and a churchyard that holds three. A quiet novel about paperwork, which is to say about what a community agrees to write down. Original sample content written for this repository — deliberately heavy chapters, for testing paged mode and pagination.

series.title: Ashfall Courier
altTitles: Vent, Two Hundred Days of Ash
series.description: Eighty vertical-strip pages across eight chapters. Sesi Amaru runs sealed letters across a city under a volcano that has not stopped for two hundred days, and one of the letters turns out to be a claim of title on a mine that was supposed to have closed. Original sample artwork drawn in plain SVG for this repository — the image-reader series in the bundled catalogue, and the one to open when you want to test the page reader with no network at all.
series.author: Kest Bramble

series.title: Frankenstein
series.description: Mary Shelley's 1818 novel, told in letters and then in Victor Frankenstein's own voice. Medium-length chapters; the epistolary opening exercises headings that are not the word "Chapter".

series.title: Na Honjaman Level-Up
altTitles: Ore Dake Level Up na Ken
俺だけレベルアップな件
series.description: 10 years ago, after “the Gate” that connected the real world with the monster world opened, some of the ordinary, everyday people received the power to hunt monsters within the Gate. They are known as “Hunters”. However, not all Hunters are powerful. My name is Sung Jin-Woo, an E-rank Hunter. I’m someone who has to risk his life in the lowliest of dungeons, the “World’s Weakest”. Having no skills whatsoever to display, I barely earned the required money by fighting in low-leveled dungeons… at least until I found a hidden dungeon with the hardest difficulty within the D-rank dungeons! In the end, as I was accepting death, I suddenly received a strange power, a quest log that only I could see, a secret to leveling up that only I know about! If I trained in accordance with my quests and hunted monsters, my level would rise. Changing from the weakest Hunter to the strongest S-rank Hunter!
series.author: h-goon (현군)

Meanwhile, the mysterious Fushiguro Megumi is tracking down a special-grade cursed object, and his search leads him to Itadori…

series.title: Tensei Shitara Slime datta Ken
altTitles: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
Moi, quand je me réincarne en Slime
In Regards to My Reincarnation as a Slime
series.description:
The ordinary Mikami Satoru found himself dying after being stabbed by a slasher. It should have been the end of his meager 37 years, but he found himself deaf and blind after hearing a mysterious voice.  
He had been reincarnated into a slime!  
  
While complaining about becoming the weak but famous slime and enjoying the life of a slime at the same time, Mikami Satoru met with the Catastrophe-level monster “Storm Dragon Veldora”, and his fate began to move.
